correctness.rationale: Exact weighted-uniform convolution and the coarea formula yield the correctly normalized Euclidean section volume. Permutation invariance proves full-sphere stationarity is equivalent to the scalar derivative for every strictly positive two-level normal. All eight rational density and derivative branches and all four breakpoint junctions were reconstructed; a quadratic root and positive Bernstein certificates establish exactly one admissible stationary ratio over all four two-level multiplicities. Sign patterns give precisely 160 unoriented hyperplanes. The standalone checker validates 75 exact identities/positivity conditions and independent hull-volume comparisons; the analytic proof, not finite sampling, establishes all real-parameter assertions.

value.rationale: A direct 2023 article explicitly conjectures uniqueness of the non-diagonal critical point on its two-block family and reports only numerical dimension-five values. This result supplies the first exact five-dimensional case, a complete full-support two-level classification across all four multiplicities, a closed algebraic normal and section volume, and an exact symmetry-orbit count. These are natural exact geometry-of-sections invariants and a substantive finite-dimensional test case rather than unmotivated parameter substitution; no general higher-dimensional extension is asserted.
